TOOLING BURST FL-3b — fire lane: shimmer disc artefact, shared noise texture, byte locks (Run C-5, FIRE LANE; conductor R-C5-102, defects F-C5-34, F-C5-33). task_id "FL-3b".

Read ONLY, in this order:
1. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/SPEC.md — § 0, § 1, § 7 rows T4a, T4h, FL-2, FL-3 and the new row "FL-3b — shimmer artefact · shared noise texture · byte locks" (your contract).
2. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/BURST_RULES.md (the TOOLING row).
3. export/godot_import.py (FL-3: the shimmer quad + BackBufferCopy + hint_screen_texture material; the additive core; the boil uniforms; the continuous whole-canvas noise texture of T4h), export/effect_kit.py, export/vfx_material.gdshader, runs/C-5/cliffside_v37/ (staged real scene, READ ONLY), runs/C-5/vfx_kits/v9/fire_burst_e0p_v2/kit.json, tests/test_godot_import.py (ContinuousResidueImportTests), tests/test_vfx_picker.py, tests/test_effect_kit.py, fixtures/ (read; re-baseline per Part C).
Do not read anything else. No web. No agents. No image generation. No pip install. stdlib + Pillow + numpy + scipy ONLY; Godot for headless import/trace only (rendered = conductor's).

PART A — F-C5-34 (rendered, conductor, PACK v37 east cast at 1080p gl_compatibility): during the residue (≈ f60–f80) a DARK OPAQUE DISC (~0.5 BH, grey-olive) appears at the residue point — the heat-shimmer quad is drawing as a solid disc instead of a distortion (the screen-texture read returns black/undefined under gl_compatibility in the captured viewport: hint_screen_texture + BackBufferCopy is NOT reliable there and the web build is gl_compatibility). Ruling: REPLACE the screen-space shimmer with the compat-safe form: an additive, very low-alpha (≤ .12) two-octave noise sheet, band-2 tint, 3-px UV wobble, over the residue for .8 s, fading with it — no BackBufferCopy, no screen texture anywhere in the exported kits. Trace clause: no node of type BackBufferCopy and no `hint_screen_texture` in any emitted scene/material; the shimmer sheet's max alpha ≤ .12; a headless 1080p capture at f72 (gl_compatibility, the conductor's probe_cast_dir.gd style) shows no pixel darker than the underlying ground within the residue footprint (sample the residue bbox before/after).

PART B — F-C5-33: ContinuousResidueImportTests.test_whole_canvas_texture_shared_by_every_material_and_cpu_cutoff → 3 noise PNGs exported, rule is 1 (T4h: one continuous whole-body noise so erosion has no seams). Make the additive core, the boil and the shimmer sheet SAMPLE THE SAME whole-canvas noise texture (different UV scale/offset per use is fine); one noise PNG per kit export; the test passes unchanged.

PART C — byte locks re-opened by FL-3 (outside suite): IceTreatmentImportTests.test_ten_existing_export_bytes_unchanged, PieceLap2ExportTests.test_six_kits_and_v1_match_488_file_pre_t4j_hash_table, ProjectileArmPickerTests.test_original_eight_export_byte_lock — re-baseline ONLY with per-lock diff summaries attributing every changed entry to FL-3/FL-3b (core, boil, contact light, shimmer sheet, noise sharing); anything else = regression, report it. The catalogue lock (BoltChainEmissionTests) stays red (E3-r1) — name it.

ACCEPTANCE (runs/C-5/t3/FL-3b/acceptance.json): Part A capture comparison + node/material scan; Part B noise PNG count per kit; Part C per-lock diffs; 14 kits byte-identical (three fire kits: kit.json only); full 17-kit catalogue export exit 0; headless import exit 0 for gl_compatibility; in-sandbox suite with the named tests green, remaining reds NAMED with the last traceback line.

Tests (unittest, stdlib): the no-screen-texture scan; the shimmer alpha clause; extend/realign only the named tests. DO NOT touch: lane/, bible/, briefs/, SPEC.md, BURST_RULES.md, REGISTER_CARD.md, JUDGE_RUBRIC.md, MANIFEST.sha256, receipt.schema.json, transcribe.schema.json, oracle/, export/replay.py, any kit except the three fire kits' kit.json, anything under runs/ except runs/C-5/t3/FL-3b/; fixtures/ only for Part C. Do not run the Godot editor GUI. Do not deploy. Confine every Godot log to runs/C-5/t3/FL-3b/ (FL-3 overwrote two T4v logs — do not repeat).
RETURN: the receipt (task_id "FL-3b"): files = every changed path with sha256; images = 0 (INTEGER); calls_used; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS / FAILED with concerns listed honestly.
